notes: Portable cold-atom gravimeter integrating all lasers, vacuum, electronics in sensor head + controller. Operating bandwidth: 20 Hz sampling rate (vs 0.1-1 Hz for lab systems). Designed for geophysical surveying, precision navigation, underground fluid monitoring. High-performance SWaP design: autonomous operation for weeks. Shipped to aerospace customer. Kasevich lab (Stanford) spin-off. Application to through-wall person detection: NOT physically plausible. A 70-kg person at 10m generates ~5 nGal differential gravity signal. AOSense gravimeter absolute precision ~1-10 uGal - person signal is 3 orders of magnitude below noise floor. Tunnel detection (meter-scale voids) is at the edge of capability for long integration times.
